subject: Journal entry correction for record VEN050-0021
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Please note that record VEN050-0021 for Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd is booked Rs 248 away from the invoice total. The invoice dated 22 Sep 2025 has a total of Rs 3,08,752, but the ledger entry shows Rs 3,09,000.

Kindly correct the ledger entry so it equals the invoice total.

Amount involved: Rs 248.
